about: The gradual of the Fourth Sunday of Advent, from Psalm 144. The nearness is conditional — He is near to those who call upon Him in truth.

s01.translation: The Lord is near to all who call upon Him: to all who call upon Him in truth.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)

s02.translation: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord, and let all flesh bless His holy name.
